afiliaciones: Profesor auxiliar de carrera - Escuela de Medicina y Ciencias de la Salud - Universidad del Rosario
perfil_profesional: Professional in Occupational Therapy graduated from the Universidad del Rosario, with a specialization in university teaching from the same University. Work experience in the area of university teaching, mental health care and in the public health sector in disability and differential populations through the Community-Based Rehabilitation (RBC) strategy, technical advice for the operation of the District Public Policy on disability and community actions in the Capital District. Teaching experience has focused on the management of disciplinary, psychosocial and community foundation subjects, field programs in mental health and community development, management of social projects, consulting, research advice and academic coordination in continuing education. With publications in the area of mental health, disability and inclusion and praxis of the Occupational Therapist in differential populations, family and community. Research and consulting on issues of disability, rehabilitation and social inclusion. The foregoing includes the performance of administrative, care, research, and extension and teaching functions, with emphasis on the management of psychosocial, community and social development programs with various population groups, generating solutions to performance problems, occupational participation and inclusion Society of individuals and groups. Teaching Award for Excellence Juan Agustín Uricoechea, Universidad Del Rosario.
